purpose: Teach: 臨時/外側/民生/自前/和風/出会える/全般/丁度

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、臨時、絶対、雇い、絶対、よく、絶対、引き受けたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? Your father took on temp work constantly when he was young. I still remember how serious he was about it.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Warm nostalgia settling into the voice. Pause after the question. Trailing softly on the memory, as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、家の、絶対、外側、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、自分で、絶対、塗ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. Your grandfather painted the whole outside of the house himself when we were young, remember? He was so committed to it.
lines.style: Gentle, alive with the memory. Voice brightens slightly on the recall. Soft affection in 'dear.' Holds the image like it's right in front of her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、民生、絶対、品、絶対、扱う、絶対、商売を、絶対、していたぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father ran a consumer goods business back then, Gran. Do you remember? He was truly devoted to it.
lines.style: Quieter now, more reflective. Each sentence deliberate, reaching back. The weight of admiration in his voice — not boasting, just remembering what mattered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、自前、絶対、で、絶対、家具、絶対、作っていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather made the furniture with his own hands, you know. I remember how proud he was of that work.
lines.style: Clear, present recollection. Voice carries the pride she's describing. Slight rise in energy when mentioning the craftsmanship. Warm and definite.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、和風、絶対、家屋、絶対、お父さん、絶対、誇りに、絶対、思ったぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father was so proud of our Japanese home. Do you remember that, Gran? That pride meant something to him.
lines.style: Softer, more vulnerable now. The pride he's describing becomes his own — almost tender. Slight catch, like the emotion is real.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、町で、絶対、素敵な、絶対、人と、絶対、出会える、絶対、ご縁が、絶対、ありましたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Those were the days when we'd meet such wonderful people in town. The connections we made — they felt like fate, don't you think?
lines.style: Dreamy, almost gentle. Voice opens up with warmth. Slight lift at 'wonderful' and 'fate.' Speaking like she's inviting him into the memory with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、家業、絶対、全般、絶対、お父さん、絶対、見渡したぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father oversaw everything about the family business back then. You remember that, don't you, Gran?
lines.style: Steady, respectful tone. Acknowledgment of the scope of his father's work. Not boastful — just factual, with underlying respect. Quiet dignity.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、丁度、絶対、時計、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、贈ってくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: He gave me a watch around that time, your grandfather did. Such a perfect gift. You remember that moment, don't you?
lines.style: Voice softens almost to a whisper. The gift holds weight — more than an object, it's an anchor of care. Tender, protected, precious.
